in_sanskrit.name: Ohidul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bright, Shining Moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ohidul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ohidul is a name of Sanskrit origin, derived from the combination of two words - 'Ohi' meaning 'bright' and 'Dul' meaning 'shining'. The name signifies a bright, shining moon, which is a symbol of calmness, tranquility, and enlightenment in Hindu culture.
